verdict.rationale: Cua documents agents running in the background on their own computers while the user keeps working (cua-docs-2, cua-docs-5). It also documents named agents with 'routines the daemon fires', notifications and pause/resume (cua-docs-24), plus unattended access to saved credentials (cua-docs-17). That covers the core of background autonomous automation, but the routine/trigger mechanism is only a single one-line mention, with no documented scheduling syntax, recurrence options or trigger types. missing for 10: detailed docs on how routines are defined and scheduled (recurring schedules, event triggers), documented failure handling and retries for unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration of background routines running reliably.
